xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3411: feat(dashboard): New Workspace as a full-page creation experience (replaces the modal)

plan.title: feat(dashboard): New Workspace as a full-page creation experience (replaces the modal)
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: Workspace creation opens a small settings-form modal. Creating a workspace is the beginning of a stream of work and deserves a full-page treatment: hero-scale name, one visible row of project chips, a calm resolved-intent status line, and a suggestion grid that teaches the empty state.
narratives.Proposal: Add a routed /workspaces/new page (hand-rolled Tab routing) implementing the mockup design/style-guide/mockups/new-workspace-page.html using PAN-3410 style primitives, reusing the PAN-3330 resolve-before-create backend unchanged via an extracted intent hook. Port every modal affordance behind a no-loss parity checklist test (including bootstrap-main), re-point all three entry points to navigate, then delete NewWorkspaceModal + controller + tests in the same PR. The page-construction items deliberately share NewWorkspacePage.tsx and serialize via blocks edges (one file, one workspace — parallel dispatch would conflict). See .pan/drafts/PAN-3411.md for decisions D-1..D-9.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Memory-driven idea suggestions (static presets only in v1)
- Migrating NewProjectModal to a page (PAN-3410 follow-up issue)
- Any backend or route change (NFR-1)
- Issue-workspace creation surfaces (user workspaces only)
- Refactoring NewWorkspaceModal to consume the new hook (it is deleted in the same PR)
- Re-implementing PAN-3410 style primitives ad hoc (hard dependency, D-9)

autoDecisions.summary: Treat PAN-3410 as a hard implementation gate (D-9) rather than halting planning.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body itself declares the dependency and the PRD forbids ad-hoc primitives; planning can complete against the mockup + primitive names, and the hazard + item ACs make the work agent stop-and-surface if it starts before PAN-3410 merges.

autoDecisions.summary: Split the PRD's WI-2/WI-4 into finer xBRIEF items (hook, target row, bootstrap-main, status strip, CTA, cutover, removal as separate items).
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo doctrine: decompose aggressively into independently reviewable tasks; the parity audit must gate modal removal as its own verifiable step.

autoDecisions.summary: Added bootstrap-main to the parity scope as a dedicated item.
autoDecisions.rationale: Code verification found the 'Register main workspace' affordance (NewWorkspaceModal.tsx:156-177, 471-498, 312-314) missing from the PRD's first-draft D-1 enumeration; dropping it would fail the no-loss audit the issue demands.

autoDecisions.summary: Modal is not refactored to consume the extracted hook; transient duplication accepted.
autoDecisions.rationale: The modal is deleted in the same PR, so refactoring it first adds review surface and risk with zero durable benefit.

autoDecisions.summary: Page-construction items share NewWorkspacePage.tsx and serialize through a total order of blocks edges instead of being split into per-item component files.
autoDecisions.rationale: Splitting into stub components would push the plan past the 25-file projected-surface finalize gate (33 files) for no behavioral gain; serialization is the truthful dispatch model for items editing one page file in one workspace, and the quality lint sanctions edges as the serialization mechanism.

items.title: Add /workspaces/new route and NewWorkspacePage shell with hero title and layout regions

narrative.Action: Add a 'workspace-new' value to the Tab union in Header.tsx, a '/workspaces/new' entry in TAB_PATHS (App/routes.ts), deep-link parsing for /workspaces/new that preserves the ?project= query param across refresh, and a dispatch branch in AppRoutes.tsx rendering a new src/dashboard/frontend/src/pages/NewWorkspacePage.tsx. The page renders the D-2 layout regions in order (project chip row placeholder, hero title, target row placeholder, hairline, status strip placeholder, hairline, idea grid placeholder) inside a generous page container, and owns the local state for mounting NewProjectModal (isOpen/onClose/onCreated) that project-chip-row will wire to its chips. The hero title is a chromeless editable input at the PAN-3410 display-xl scale, autofocused, placeholder 'Untitled workspace' in muted ink, autocomplete off, spellcheck false. ?project=<key> preselects that project in page state (accept key or display name, matching modal preset semantics). Use only PAN-3410 primitives for styling; if they are not merged, STOP and surface the dependency (D-9) rather than improvising styles. Visual contract: design/style-guide/mockups/new-workspace-page.html.

items.title: Given the SPA, when navigating to /workspaces/new, then NewWorkspacePage renders the seven layout regions (chip row, hero title, target row, hairline, status strip, hairline, idea grid) in D-2 order
Given a browser refresh on /workspaces/new?project=<key>, when the page loads, then it renders the creation page and preselects that project (deep-link parse preserves the query param)
Hero title renders autofocused, showing 'Untitled workspace' as muted empty-state hint text at the PAN-3410 display-xl scale from the style-guide primitive, not an ad-hoc font-size
Extract useWorkspaceCreateIntent hook: debounced resolve, stale tracking, findings, create

narrative.Action: Port the resolve-before-create logic from NewWorkspaceModal.tsx (lines 199-263) into a reusable hook at src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/workspace/new/useWorkspaceCreateIntent.ts, consumed by the new page; do NOT refactor the modal (it is deleted in modal-removal — transient duplication is deliberate, D-3). The hook owns: form state (name, projectKey, targetPath, mode, parentBranch); a 300ms debounce (reuse the RESOLVE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300 contract from NewWorkspaceModal.tsx:24) calling POST /api/workspace-registry/resolve; stale=true on every field change cleared only after a successful resolve; findingsFor(field) filtering resolver findings per field; canCreate = !creating && !stale && Boolean(intent) && !hasFindings; submitIntent POSTing /api/workspace-registry and surfacing 422 responses as findings; isolated mode dropping targetPath from the resolve request (effectiveTargetPath = ''). All debounce tests use vi.useFakeTimers() + advanceTimersByTimeAsync — never real timers.

items.title: Given rapid field edits, when the 300ms debounce window elapses, then exactly one resolve POST fires per settle (fake-timer tested)
Given any field change, when a resolve is in flight or pending, then stale is true and canCreate is false until a successful resolve clears it
Given a 422 create response, when submitIntent rejects, then the response findings surface through findingsFor and no onCreated navigation occurs
Given isolated mode, when a resolve request fires, then the request body omits targetPath
Target row: folder chip + picker, shared/isolated toggle, advanced parent-branch disclosure

narrative.Action: Implement the D-2 target row in NewWorkspacePage per the mockup: a folder chip showing the resolved target directory with a chevron that opens the picker (registered project targets from GET /api/workspace-registry/project-targets plus a Browse… option mounting the existing FolderPicker component unchanged); the shared/isolated mode toggle on the same quiet line (isolated disables/ignores the target chip); and an 'advanced' disclosure revealing the parent-branch input, whose value is included in the resolve payload. Wire every control through useWorkspaceCreateIntent. Preserve modal behaviors: switching project drops the old target selection; isolated mode previews worktree path/branch in resolution.

items.title: Given a selected project, when the chevron opens the picker, then registered targets render plus a Browse… option, and choosing Browse… mounts FolderPicker whose selection sets targetPath
Given isolated mode is toggled on, when the form renders, then the target chip is disabled/ignored and the resolve request omits targetPath
Given the advanced disclosure is open and a parent branch is entered, when the resolve fires, then the payload includes parentBranch
Given a target was chosen, when the project changes, then the old target selection is dropped
Port the 'Register main workspace' bootstrap affordance to the page

narrative.Action: Port the bootstrap-main affordance from NewWorkspaceModal.tsx (probe at lines 156-177, UI at 471-498, submit at 312-314) — the no-loss row most easily dropped. When the selected project has no main workspace, the page probes the registry with includeArchived=true (an archived main still counts as existing) and renders a 'Register main workspace' action; clicking it POSTs /api/workspace-registry with { project, bootstrapMain: true }; the action is hidden when a main workspace exists.

items.title: Given the selected project has no main workspace, when the probe returns, then the page renders the 'Register main workspace' action
Given the action is clicked, when the POST fires, then the body is { project: <key>, bootstrapMain: true }
Given the project has a main workspace (including an archived one via includeArchived=true), when the probe returns, then the action does not render
Status strip: dot-metadata resolved-intent line with findings rendered in place

narrative.Action: Implement the D-3 status strip per the mockup: a dot-metadata line composed from the live resolution — always 'Memory enabled' (emerald outcome dot), then mode ('Files shared' for shared / 'Isolated worktree'), then git posture ('git repository' / 'no git detected'), then parent branch when overridden — separated by middots. When findings exist, the affected segment is replaced by the finding text in the destructive token; the strip IS the validation surface and no separate error panel renders.

items.title: Given a clean shared-mode resolution on a git repo, when the strip renders, then it shows 'Memory enabled · Files shared · git repository'
Given isolated mode, when the strip renders, then the mode segment reads 'Isolated worktree'
Given a parent-branch override, when the strip renders, then the branch appears as an additional segment
Given findings from the resolver, when the strip renders, then the affected segment is replaced by the finding text in the destructive token and no separate error panel renders
Start workspace CTA with Enter-to-submit and invalidate/activate/navigate on success

narrative.Action: Implement the D-4 status-strip right side and submit path: a quiet mono CANCEL (returns to the previous view) and the large 'Start workspace' CTA with an ↵ keycap using the PAN-3410 cta+keycap primitive. The CTA is disabled while creating/stale/no-intent/findings (identical canCreate contract). Enter anywhere in the form submits when enabled. On 201: invalidate the ['workspace-registry'] query key, POST the activate endpoint with the percent-encoded workspace id, and navigate into the workspace view — thread an onCreated callback from App.tsx's existing onSelectWorkspace (the same post-create posture as useNewWorkspaceModal.onCreated at useNewWorkspaceModal.ts:58) through the AppRoutes branch into the page; an activation failure still navigates.

items.title: Given the resolution is stale or findings are present, when the strip renders, then the Start workspace CTA is disabled
Given the form is valid, when Enter is pressed in any field, then submitIntent fires exactly once
Given a 201 create, when the promise resolves, then ['workspace-registry'] is invalidated, activate is POSTed with the percent-encoded id, and the app navigates to the workspace view
Given activation fails after a 201 create, when the activate POST rejects, then the app still navigates to the workspace view
Project chip row: recency-ordered chips, overflow menu, NewProjectModal integration

narrative.Action: Implement the D-5 chip row per the mockup using PAN-3410 chip primitives: a dashed 'add existing' chip and a 'new project' chip, then one chip per known project ordered by most recent workspace lastAccessedAt (source: GET /api/workspace-registry rows, lastAccessedAt field per Sidebar.tsx:160), collapsing beyond ~5 chips into a 'more projects' overflow menu. Sole registered project preselects its chip; ?project= preset preselects (key or display name). 'add existing' and 'new project' open NewProjectModal via the page-local mount that route-and-page-shell established (the modal component itself is unchanged); on its onCreated, the new project's chip appears selected.

items.title: Given multiple projects, when the row renders, then chips are ordered by most recent workspace lastAccessedAt per project
Given exactly one registered project and no preset, when the page loads, then its chip is preselected
Given more than ~5 projects, when the row renders, then overflow collapses into a 'more projects' menu whose selections behave like chips
Given 'new project' or 'add existing' is clicked, when NewProjectModal's onCreated fires, then the new project's chip appears selected on the page
Static idea-card grid with uppercase mono category labels and hero prefill

narrative.Action: Implement the D-6 idea grid per the mockup: an 'Ideas for your next workspace' eyebrow heading and six static soft-card presets, verbatim from the mockup — AUTOMATE: 'Nightly dependency-audit sweep across all registered projects'; DELEGATE: 'Triage the untriaged backlog and draft a priority proposal'; EXPLORE: 'Map how the merge train decides dispatch order'; BUILD: 'Prototype kanban swimlanes grouped by project'; PLAN: 'Plan the Q3 cost-governor roadmap from open issues'; DESIGN: 'Redesign the agent card footer around the new style guide'. Each card is an eyebrow category label (uppercase mono) + short title; clicking sets the hero title to the example text and focuses the hero for editing. No model calls, no memory reads, no network requests.

items.title: Given the page loads, when the idea grid renders, then all six cards appear with uppercase mono category labels and the mockup's example titles
Given a card is clicked, when the handler runs, then the hero title is set to the card's example text and the hero input receives focus
Given the grid renders, when network activity is observed, then no requests fire from the idea-card code path
No-loss parity checklist suite enumerating every modal affordance against the page

expected_outputs: NewWorkspacePage.parity.test.tsx passes with every checklist row ticked

narrative.Action: Write the D-1 gate: a parity checklist test that enumerates every modal affordance as an explicit row and asserts the page covers it. Rows: name input; project select incl. sole-project default; preset accepting key or display name; target dropdown + Browse/FolderPicker; shared/isolated toggle (isolated drops targetPath); advanced parent branch; live resolved preview (path, branch, parent branch, git status, worktree flag, unregistered-target warning); inline per-field findings; Create disabled while stale/invalid; bootstrap-main ('Register main workspace'); form reset behavior equivalent to the modal's reopen-clears-state; onCreated = invalidate ['workspace-registry'] + POST activate (percent-encoded) + navigate, with activation failure still navigating. Each row references the page test that covers it; the suite fails if any row is unmapped. This suite must be green before entry-point-cutover and modal-removal start.

items.title: Given the D-1 checklist, when the suite runs, then every enumerated affordance row maps to a passing page test
Given a row loses its covering test, when the suite runs, then it fails naming the uncovered affordance
Re-point sidebar +, command palette, and per-project buttons to navigate to /workspaces/new

narrative.Action: Per D-7, re-point all three entry points to navigate instead of opening the modal: the sidebar WORKSPACES + button (Sidebar.tsx:598-608, currently wired at App.tsx:853) navigates to /workspaces/new?project=<selectedProjectKey> when a project is selected; the command-palette 'new-workspace' action (CommandPalette.tsx:458-467, wired at App.tsx:1000) navigates to /workspaces/new; the per-project button (ProjectOverview.tsx:337-353) navigates to /workspaces/new?project=<key>. Navigation uses the existing setActiveTab + pushState pattern. The modal stays mounted until modal-removal; this item only changes where the entry points lead.
